title: Prepending to the main stack
statement: For every stack word $xs$ and symbol $b$, updating the assignment that places $xs$ on the main stack and leaves the other stacks empty so that its main stack contains $b$ followed by $xs$ yields the assignment that places $b$ followed by $xs$ on the main stack and leaves the other stacks empty.
replaced:
Prepending a symbol to the main stack of the assignment that stores a word on the
main stack (other stacks empty) yields the assignment storing the extended word.
